title: Legume-Cereal Nitrogen Replenishment Cycle
rationale: Following nutrient-extractive cereals, millets, or cotton with nitrogen-fixing pulses (Chickpea, Pigeon Pea) restores biological nitrogen reserves.
soilHealthImpact: Improves available soil nitrogen and organic residue for the subsequent monsoon season.

title: Continuous Cotton Pest & Disease Break
rationale: Avoid planting cotton on the same parcel in consecutive years to disrupt pink bollworm life cycles and soil-borne wilt pressure.
soilHealthImpact: Reduces pathogen carryover and diversifies root exudates.

title: Post-Monsoon Residual Moisture Matching
rationale: Short-duration Kharif crops harvested by October preserve sufficient profile moisture in Vertisols for low-water Rabi Chickpea or Rabi Sorghum.
soilHealthImpact: Maximizes seasonal water productivity without groundwater over-extraction.
